newsitem.title: UK: Finer Bradford wooltops buoyed by strong Aussie.
newsitem.headline: Finer Bradford wooltops buoyed by strong Aussie.

text.p: A strengthening Australian dollar against the pound counterbalanced a small drop in raw wool prices and ensured firm selling rates for fine tops, Bradford market sources said.
There was a modest revival in new business after a very slow start to the week which was also the work of the Aussie, they said.
Evidence of some constancy in the call for deliveries both here and on the Continent encouraged buyers to act now rather than risk losses on currency, traders said.
But demand for coarser tops was extremely poor, they added. --London Newsroom, +44 171 542 8071
